name: intro
narration: YouTube has some of the best teachers in the world. Vortex gives you a way to learn from them.

name: courses
narration: Real courses, built from real lessons. Every video in the right order, and credited to the creator who made it.

name: search
narration: Just ask, in plain English. Vortex finds the lesson, and the moment it's taught.

name: progress
narration: Your place is saved to the second. So you can pick up right where you left off.

name: quiz
narration: When a video ends, a short quiz checks what stuck. Retake it until you pass.

name: plan
narration: And for anything else, just describe your goal. Vortex builds you a plan.

name: close
narration: Vortex. Learn anything, the way a course teaches it.
